decisions: Local rows are camelCase (Dexie index names are) and DERIVED from the generated domain types with a key-remapping type plus _sync, so a new column arrives with npm run gen:types and the mapper test fails until they agree.

The branded ids from task 003 caught 9 real mistakes at typecheck (plain string ids passed to typed Dexie keys); every repository and hook parameter is now the branded id type, no casts spread around.
OutboxOp.table widened to highlights | notes | artifacts (02 §6.1 says it widens); recorded as defaulted.
uuidv7 is hand-written (RFC 9562), no library, with a ponytail note: random within one millisecond, not ordered.
useDb() returns the open db (no re-render on a profile switch); the shell remounts on sign-in/out (task 008). ponytail note in db/index.ts.

mappers.ts (plan doc) over normalizers.ts (04); 04's sample Dexie schema is the old one and lost to 02 §6.1 by precedence.
